Package game.positions.mine

Class BreakableGround

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.positions.mine.BreakableGround
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Breakable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CopperNode, Rock
public abstract class BreakableGround extends Ground implements Breakable
Abstract base class for Ground that cannot be entered and must be broken to clear the way. Breaking it always leaves dirt behind and drops an item on its tile; subclasses only say which item drops and what else happens.
